responsibility: Acts as GCC’s dispatch wrapper for <stdint.h>: in hosted environments it includes the system’s next stdint.h while forcing the C++ limit/constant macro exposure expected by GCC, and in non-hosted or freestanding use it falls back to GCC’s own stdint-gcc.h definitions. Its responsibility is not to define integer types itself, but to select the appropriate provider and normalize macro visibility across hosted versus freestanding compilation.
